svg.text: Pilot client protection without locking out the learner
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Client security portal and the assigned desktop
Verify this host’s actual client EDR onboarding and recent reporting, using the supported
licensed product’s current steps. Use a vendor-approved safe test and record its actual result.
Server and client portals/features can differ.
Apply one pilot policy through a licensed/supported management channel. Test sign-in, desktop
launch and necessary applications. If using Conditional Access or Intune, confirm the needed
licenses and a tested administrator recovery account before enforcement.
Do not isolate the only remote session host as your first response exercise without a separate
supported recovery path. The earlier containment practice belongs on the VMware member-server
Check: Client protection is verified without accidentally removing all recovery access.
